Method of Attack: Encrypting Confluence instances unpatched against CVE-2022-26134
Impacted Systems: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center instances
Attack Vector: Exploitation of OGNL injection vulnerability CVE-2022-26134 allowing unauthenticated remote code execution
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted Confluence configuration files submitted to ID-Ransomware
Reports of active exploitation in the wild
Microsoft confirmation of Confluence servers exploited to install Cerber2021
